deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to "Settings" > "Apps".
Click on "Get apps or themes" and search for the app that provides the returns reason capture form feature.
Install and configure the app according to its instructions.
In the Shopify admin panel, go to "Settings" > "Policies" > "Return Policy".
Scroll down to the "Return reasons" section and click on the "Add return reason" button.
Enter a name for the return reason and select the corresponding reason type (e.g. 'Defective product' or 'Not as described').
Click "Save" to save the new return reason.
In the Shopify admin panel, go to "Settings" > "Apps" and find the app that provides the returns reason capture form feature.
Click on the app's settings and navigate to the "Form configuration" section.
Select the return reason you created earlier as the default reason for the form.
Copy the provided JavaScript code snippet from the app's settings and paste it into your Shopify theme's liquid file (e.g. layout.liquid).
In the Shopify admin panel, go to "Online Store" > "Themes" and click on the "Actions" dropdown menu next to your active theme.
Select "Edit code" and navigate to the section where you pasted the JavaScript code snippet.
Click "Save" to save the changes to your theme's liquid file.
In the Shopify admin panel, go to "Settings" > "Policies" > "Return Policy" and click on the "Test return flow" button.
The returns reason capture form should now be embedded in the return flow. Test it by initiating a return from the customer's account.
